metric: Start latency: the tile's UI-thread tap handler (Gesture.Tap onEnd, its performance.now()) to the first displayed frame in which the photo's box differs from the resting tile's by more than 1 pt (iOS) or 2 dp (Android) on any edge: the frame the run has begun. It does not depend on how far the curve moves the photo.
curve: 500 ms, Easing.out(Easing.cubic) for every variant (the start-latency bench switch, galleryStartBench.ts): react-native-screen-choreography's only timed curve, copied by the others so all eight run the same one. SmoothClipView: ClipEasings.easeOutCubic (exact).
cells: No load. Per variant 3 warm-up cycles (warmUp: true), then 10 measured open/close cycles of tile 4; all eight variants in one recording per platform (bench.yaml).

secondary.firstMotion: the old mount time: the first frame with the photo moved more than 4 pt (dp) from its tile
secondary.fittedRunStart: each moving frame's box height (size) or top edge (position) mapped back through the curve to the run's start; median over the frames between 10 and 90 % progress

ios.clock: Times run from the tap handler, placed on the native trace's clock (CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW: the handler's performance.now(), the hardware touch-up and the flights' run epochs); the recording is placed on it with the flights (calibration).
ios.recording: showcases/gallery-mount-time/gallery-start-latency-ios.mp4 in app-showcase (untracked); recording times are in ms from its start

device.gpu: -gpu host (the AVD's auto mode picks lavapipe, a software renderer, for this API 37 image on macOS: about 35 fps)

android.build: Release (arm64-v8a), the same code as iOS
android.clock: The screen recording shares no clock with the app, so frames are timed from the tap marker's frame: the first frame after the handler. touchUpToHandlerMs comes from the kernel's touch events (getevent) and the handler's log (logcat), both on the uptime clock.
android.recording: showcases/gallery-mount-time/gallery-start-latency-android.mp4 in app-showcase (untracked); recording times are in ms from its start

versions.react-native-smooth-clip-view: gallery-mount-time branch (0.6.0 flights + gallery bench), source
